usage: agentware fanout merge-queue [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--repo REPO]
                                    [--kb-repo KB_REPO]
                                    [--integration-branch INTEGRATION_BRANCH]
                                    [--base BASE] [--kb-base KB_BASE]
                                    [--gate GATE] [--no-gates] [--dry-run]
                                    [features ...]

positional arguments:
  features              lanes to integrate (default: all registered lanes)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --repo REPO           package repo (default: this agentware repo)
  --kb-repo KB_REPO     integration KB repo (default: resolved knowledge dir)
  --integration-branch INTEGRATION_BRANCH
                        integration branch name (default: integration)
  --base BASE           base ref to create the package integration branch
  --kb-base KB_BASE     base ref to create the KB integration branch
  --gate GATE           post-merge gate command (repeatable; overrides the
                        default steering+eval+test gates)
  --no-gates            skip the post-merge gates
  --dry-run             print the plan; integrate nothing
